records.title: DGNNFlow: A Streaming Dataflow Architecture for Real-Time Edge-based Dynamic GNN Inference in HL-LHC Trigger Systems
records.reason: DGNNFlow accelerates FPGA GNN inference for particle-physics triggers, not LLM serving.

records.title: The Phasor Transformer: Resolving Attention Bottlenecks on the Unit Circle
records.reason: Phasor Transformer replaces dot-product attention with phase shifts and DFT coupling for O(N log N) time-series mixing; synthetic forecasting shows an efficiency/accuracy frontier but not superiority to attention. No language-model or deployment inference evaluation.
